summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the sulphur/sulphuric-acid chokepoint with one reference customer anchor and three underfollowed direct or second-order candidates. The strongest direct underfollowed mapping is Ecovyst, a small/mid-cap sulfuric-acid regeneration and virgin-acid supplier with explicit 2026 mining-demand commentary. Martin Midstream is the purest sulfur-logistics shadow candidate but is below the preferred market-cap floor and should be treated as a speculative exception. Hawkins is a chemical-distribution hypothesis: it has sulfuric-acid distribution exposure, but the margin/transit pass-through thesis needs verification. Mosaic is included as a reference/context name because its Brazil SSP curtailment directly validates sulfur cost pressure in fertilizer production, but it is more likely a squeezed user than a clean beneficiary.
